title: Normalize generated JSON before exact staged review
failure_signature: The exact staged review rejected a PowerShell-generated validation receipt whose UTF-8 BOM was incompatible with strict JSON decoding.
trigger_preconditions: JSON was generated by mixed Windows tooling
the exact staged reviewer decodes strict UTF-8
the content is otherwise valid JSON
candidate_workaround: Rewrite the bounded receipt through reviewed UTF-8-without-BOM text, retain all rows, then rerun strict staged parsing.
recurrence_guard: Generate repository JSON with the family write_json helper or explicitly verify the first bytes before staging.
rollback: Keep the staged review invalid and retain the original parsing failure if normalization changes semantics.
scope_boundary: Encoding normalization preserves content only; it does not provide signatures, independent review, or broader assurance.
